note: This sheet is RGB with no alpha channel, so slicing finds one piece covering the whole sheet. That is correct for a fixed-grid plate: select the single piece and use "Split selected on grid" at the layout below. 1254x1254 at 10x10. It already ships as a hand-written tileset built by art-source/tilesets/normalize_tilesets.py. Exporting over it would rewrite the ids and coordinates that GenMappingRegistry references, so treat this as a sheet to inspect or adopt deliberately, not to re-export casually. Its 3x3 wall and floor patches are what block grouping was built for: urban.wall is a wall-3x3 at origin (3,0), urban.floor a floor-3x3 at (0,0).
